exposure: laparoscopic repair of severe cesarean scar defect (CSD)
outcome: reproductive outcomes (conception, live births, uterine rupture, severe obstetric complications)
cohort: Thirty-three women diagnosed with severe cesarean scar defect (defined as RMT <2.5 mm) who underwent laparoscopic surgical repair between November 2008 and January 2021.
finding: Laparoscopic repair of severe cesarean scar defect (CSD) led to durable anatomical restoration, significant symptom relief, and favorable reproductive outcomes with low recurrence rates over the long term.
mod_finding: Severe CSD recurrence was noted in 6.7% of cases after a subsequent cesarean delivery.
